lines.en: I inch forward along the leaf's vein.
My body arches and stretches.
Six feet grip the leaf.

lines.zh: 我在叶边停下来看了看。
lines.en: I stop at the leaf edge and look.
Nothing ahead but air. I turn back.
I crawl over a hole I chewed.

lines.zh: 我在叶子中间绕了一圈。
lines.en: I go once around the middle of the leaf.
This leaf will feed me for days.

lines.zh: 我尽量不走到叶子的背面。
lines.en: I try not to stray onto the underside.
Fine hairs stand along my back.
I stretch my head forward.

lines.zh: 我挪到另一片叶上，很慢。
lines.en: I move to another leaf, slowly.
My feet hook over the leaf rim.

lines.zh: 这里的光比较暗，我喜欢。
lines.en: The light is dimmer here. I like it.
I stop beside the stalk.
There are no more leaves beyond this.
I lie flat without moving.

lines.zh: 我只吃树叶，别的都不碰。
lines.en: I eat only leaves. Nothing else.
The hole I chewed has dried at its edge.

lines.zh: 我在听房子里的人走动。
lines.en: I listen to the people moving in the house.
I am close to the windowsill.
The stalk sways; I press flatter.

lines.zh: 我在叶子上待了一整天。
lines.en: I have spent a whole day on this leaf.
I am a little bigger than yesterday.
My skin feels tight.
A bug passes beside me.
I paid it no attention.
The leaf is starting to have holes.

lines.zh: 你弯腰看我，我缩了一下。
lines.en: You bend to look; I shrink back.

lines.zh: 我在叶子的边上，容易被看见。
lines.en: I am at the leaf's edge, easy to see.

lines.zh: 你手里的叶子离我很近。
lines.en: The leaf in your hand is very close.
I edge toward the leaf's rim.
If you keep still, I will shift again.
I live in the village and eat leaves.
That is fear, not a threat.
Please do not touch me.

lines.zh: 我掉下去就活不了多久。
lines.en: If I fall, I will not last long.
You step back, and I relax.

lines.zh: 我缩得更紧，连头都收进去了。
lines.en: I curl tighter, head drawn in too.
My feet can no longer grip.

lines.zh: 压过的地方，我缩成一节。
lines.en: Where you pressed, I pull into a segment.
I let out a short thread.
I hang myself on the thread.
It hurts too much to move.
The leaf swings and so do I.
Fluid runs out of me.
I am rarely in such pain.
Playing dead works better than struggling.
The edge of that leaf is tender.
I crawl toward it.
I lift my head and reach it.
I take the first bite, very small.
Sap runs into my mouth.
This is better than what I have.
I eat a half circle out of it.
I back away as I eat.
When this leaf is done I move on.
Any more? I lift my head.

lines.zh: 你碰了叶子，我脚下晃了。
lines.en: You touch the leaf and my footing sways.
All six feet are pinned to the leaf.
I curl into a ring and freeze.

lines.zh: 我的脚在叶面上滑了一下。
lines.en: My feet slip once on the leaf.
You move away, and only then do I dare move.
That frightened me badly.
I crawl on a little.
I keep well away from the leaf edge.
My feet leave marks on the vein.

lines.zh: 我要在这片叶子上多待一会儿。
lines.en: I will stay on this leaf a while longer.
There is another on the underside of the leaf.

lines.zh: 我们各吃一边，互不干涉。
lines.en: We eat opposite sides and leave each other be.
It eats the same leaves I do.
We touch heads.
Then we go our own ways.

lines.zh: 这一片叶子容得下两条。
lines.en: This leaf holds two of us.
Later we will each spin a cocoon.

lines.zh: 挂在同一棵树的叶子上。
lines.en: Hanging from leaves of the same tree.
By then we will not eat anymore.
For now, eat more.
I am eating. I do not pick things up.
Something lands on the leaf.
My antennae touch it. Cold.
It is in my way.
I push with my head. It will not move.
So I go around.
I can't budge it, so I crawl around.
I touch it. Hard.

lines.zh: 我只啃叶子，别的一概不碰。
lines.en: I only chew leaves, nothing else.
I return to the middle of the leaf.
Something is at the leaf's edge.
I stop chewing.
I raise my head a little.
It is very near me.
I curl up, to look like a vein.

lines.zh: 我背上的颜色和叶子一样。
lines.en: My back matches the leaf.
It is still moving.
I crawl under the leaf.
It can no longer see me.
I wait under the leaf until it goes.
I can only hide. I cannot chase.
Its shadow sweeps the leaf.
I am on the underside.
Under the leaf vein, I curl into a segment.
It turns the leaf over.
Light suddenly falls on me.
I go entirely rigid.
It is looking at me.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，希望它失去兴趣。
lines.en: I hold still and hope it loses interest.

lines.zh: 我缩成一小团，等它收手。
lines.en: I curl small and wait for it to pull back.
I can only butt at it.
I push my head against its finger.
That force is nothing at all.
It flips the leaf.
I fall and catch on the stalk.
I hang in the air, swinging.
The ground far below.
I climb back up, bit by bit.
At last I am on the leaf again.
This time I cling tighter.
I bite through the eggshell and crawl out.

lines.zh: 第一口吃的是自己的壳。
lines.en: My first meal is my own shell.
Then I start on the leaf.
This is a tree in a village.
The eaves are not far.
The wind smells of cooking smoke.
I crawl to the middle of the leaf.
It is thickest here. Safest.
I begin to chew the leaf.
I will eat until I spin.

lines.zh: 热气一烘，我的皮就皱起来了。
lines.en: The heat shrivels my skin at once.

lines.zh: 落地的声音很闷，我翻过来。
lines.en: The landing is dull; I right myself.

lines.zh: 水浸透了我，我蹬不动了。
lines.en: Water soaks me and my legs stop working.

lines.zh: 气浪把叶子和我一起掀飞。
lines.en: The blast flings the leaf and me with it.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过叶子，把我震下来。
lines.en: An arrow grazes the leaf and shakes me loose.

lines.zh: 奇怪的光落下来，我全身发麻。
lines.en: Strange light falls and I go numb all over.

lines.zh: 叶子都吃完了，我开始发软。
lines.en: The leaves are gone and I am going limp.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我整条身子都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the tree and my whole body stiffens.

lines.zh: 叶子没了，我在黑里往下落。
lines.en: The leaf is gone and I fall through black.
